reviews.name: Deepika Cheemala
reviews.quote: I was very scared before my root canal treatment, but the doctor explained everything clearly and made me feel comfortable. The procedure was almost painless, and the staff were polite and supportive.
reviews.full_text: I had a very good experience at AJ Dental Clinic. I was very scared before my root canal treatment, but the doctor explained everything clearly and made me feel comfortable. The procedure was almost painless, and the staff were polite and supportive. The clinic was clean and well maintained. Thank you doctor and team for taking good care of me. I would definitely recommend this clinic to others.

reviews.name: Tarun Gundrathi
reviews.quote: From the moment I walked in, I felt genuinely cared for and comfortable. The staff is warm and professional, and the doctors are incredibly skilled and attentive.
reviews.full_text:
I had an amazing experience with this team of dental and aesthetic doctors! From the moment I walked in, I felt genuinely cared for and comfortable. The staff is warm and professional, and the doctors are incredibly skilled and attentive.

They explained every step clearly and made sure I was relaxed throughout the procedures. The results exceeded my expectations — my smile looks better than ever, and I feel so much more confident now.

I truly appreciate their attention to detail, modern equipment, and the extra effort they put into ensuring patient comfort. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for top-quality dental and aesthetic treatments. Thank you for the exceptional care and for giving me a reason to smile brighter!

doctors.name: Dr. B. Joe Praveen
doctors.bio_draft: Dr. B. Joe Praveen is our Orthodontist and an Assistant Professor. He specialises in the diagnosis, prevention and correction of misaligned teeth and jaws, looking after patients who need braces, clear aligners, bite correction, teeth alignment and smile enhancement — helping them achieve a healthier, well-aligned and confident smile through personalised orthodontic care.

doctors.name: Dr. M. Ankitha
doctors.display_credentials: MDS · Oral Physician & Radiologist · Assistant Professor
doctors.bio_draft: Dr. M. Ankitha is a dental healthcare provider — MDS, Oral Physician & Radiologist, and an Assistant Professor. She authored the book Cone Beam Computed Tomography: Oral and Maxillofacial Diagnosis & Applications, which focuses on advanced dental radiography. Dr. Ankitha has also contributed to several international clinical research papers, exploring areas such as transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) on salivary flow in diabetic patients, maxillary odontomas, and forensic cheiloscopy.
